title: jasione supina subsp. pontica
intro: Jasione supina subsp. pontica, commonly known as Pontic bellflower or Pontic rockjasmine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Jasione supina subsp. pontica include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help in relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
